context: Parse or recognize structured secret fields and bounded prose assignments before the existing DSN/userinfo policy; test both exception_message and top-level message while keeping unrelated ordinary text unchanged.
description: make_execution_error scrubs DSN assignments and URL userinfo but misses structured exception text such as JSON password/token fields and prose of the form password VALUE. A driven origin/develop response retained JSON_SECRET, JSON_TOKEN, and PROSE_SECRET in details.exception_message. Extend the scrubber with behavior-driven structured/prose coverage. Keep the conservative policy that masks all URL userinfo, including a non-secret-looking username, because the text channel cannot reliably distinguish identity from bearer material; document that over-redaction as intentional rather than weakening it.

verifications.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'import json; from benchbox.mcp.errors import make_execution_error; a=make_execution_error("failed", exception=Exception("driver returned {\"password\": \"JSON_SECRET\", \"token\": \"JSON_TOKEN\"}")); b=make_execution_error("failed", exception=Exception("driver returned password PROSE_SECRET")); text=json.dumps([a,b]); assert all(x not in text for x in ("JSON_SECRET","JSON_TOKEN","PROSE_SECRET"))'
verifications.description: structured and prose secret values are absent from MCP error responses
verifications.expected: exits 1 on an unfixed tree because structured/prose secrets survive; exits 0 after MCP scrubbing is extended

verifications.description: existing MCP error tests remain green
verifications.expected: passes before and after as a regression guard

verifications.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'from benchbox.mcp.errors import make_execution_error; out=make_execution_error("failed", exception=Exception("https://public-user@example.com/report")); assert out["details"]["exception_message"]=="https://****@example.com/report"'
verifications.expected: passes before and after as a regression guard; over-redaction is intentional
